cfgEngineAi: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint with your key
cfgTarget: Target language code (e.g. zh-CN, en, ja).
cfgEndpoint: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Groq, Ollama, …).
cfgModel: Model name for the AI engine.
cfgProvider: AI provider id. Use **DualTran: Choose AI Provider** to pick from the built-in list and the 200+ providers in models.dev; the command fills in the matching endpoint and model.
cfgReasoning: How much reasoning effort to request. Unknown or unsupported levels are dropped automatically.
cfgReasoningLowest: Use the lowest level the selected model accepts (default)
cfgReasoningDefault: Send no reasoning parameter — let the provider decide
warnSelectText: DualTran: select the text to replace.
inputApiKeyPromptExisting: Stored in the OS keychain via VS Code SecretStorage. Leave empty to keep the current key.
errorNoApiKey: No API key set (DualTran: Set AI API Key).
pickProviderPlaceholder: Built-in first, then every provider models.dev knows
